videos.subject: Would you drive 20 minutes to save $5? 🧮
videos.script: You're more willing to drive to save five dollars on cheap stuff. People were asked: would you drive twenty minutes to another store to save five dollars on a calculator? On a fifteen-dollar one, sixty-eight percent said yes. On a hundred-and-twenty-five-dollar one, only twenty-nine percent. Same five dollars. That's why
